notes:
Evaporated & condensed milk (old k15): I merged the three Piracanjuba condensed-milk variants (0% Gordura, Seleção, Zero Lactose) into one model, 'Piracanjuba Leite Condensado'. Fat and lactose variants are attributes, not separate products. Tube packaging became a type. This leaves 9 models, down from 11. I kept the Carnation range only here.

Milk powder (old k106): this kind moved here from the baby department. Its types are now skimmed, whole and instant. I kept one model per brand, because the skimmed/whole split is now covered by the types. I dropped Amul Whole Milk Powder, Verka Skimmed Milk Powder and Safariland Skimmed Milk Powder, leaving 9 models, down from 12. The old source was empty and remains empty, because no research was allowed on this shelf; it needs a source in a later pass.

Dulce de leche (old k17): I made arequipe, manjar, cajeta (goat's milk) and doce de leite into types and added them as aliases. All 7 models are kept. I dropped the duplicate Carnation range, since the Carnation model already covers it and repeating ranges across kinds is a finding.

Across the shelf, I added no new brands, archetypes or kinds.
